title: A refusal over a local socket that answers a code and a message
description: Salaam's operator socket (HTTP over a Unix socket on one host) answers every refusal `{ "code": "<snake_code>", "error": "<message>" }` (salaam:src/service/router.ts, sendError). For local IPC only: an HTTP API between products uses error.v1 (phase 3, ruling 2; phase 4, ruling 1). `code` follows flat-error.v1's code pattern and is a name from contracts/error-codes.json in this envelope; `error` is the message, for people and logs, never for branching. Other fields are allowed beside them.

code.description: AgentPod's node-agent reads a code of at most 64 characters and drops a longer one.
